name: Dieter
site: telenet.be · Internet, mobile, phone and TV, Belgium
headline: Turn Telenet’s usage data into bundles that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells internet, mobile, TV and streaming combos, family offers and promotions to every visitor in the same way, including the customers who already pay you and only want to change their tariff.

Once a customer is in my account, what they stream, which add-ons they keep and when their mobile data goes quiet is your strongest signal. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same family offer as everyone else, or a promotion that was never meant for them.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, the AI reads usage drops, support contacts and tariff changes, then picks the offer, channel and moment most likely to keep that customer this week.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match the add-on to each customer
cases.text: Next best family plan, streaming option or add-on for each customer, based on the lines they already hold. Customers on the right tariff stop getting upgrade mails meant for others.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep streaming in use every week
cases.text: Personal TV and streaming suggestions by email and in my account, timed to each household’s viewing habits, so they keep using what they already pay for each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
